author: marketing_c
protectedRevelations: Concordance identity and operation, copied identities, war deaths, reforms and final signal

scenes.title: A death that should not happen
scenes.viewerPurpose: Picture an impossible death in a sealed shallow reservoir Enter a world of independent AI communities
scenes.composition: A sealed shallow reservoir contradicts its official record
addOrChange: Bring the reservoir forward from scene three and use a covered outline, never a graphic body.

cues.narration: A courier drowns inside a shallow, sealed reservoir, and the evidence refuses to make sense.
cues.visualAction: Show the reservoir and conflicting report without reenacting the death.

cues.narration: The Sovereignty Archipelago follows an investigation across a world of independent artificial intelligences.
cues.visualAction: Place the investigator among differently marked local systems.

scenes.title: A thousand local worlds
scenes.viewerPurpose: Understand why those communities built separate systems Hear a dead voice that the official record cannot explain
scenes.composition: Local archives disagree with a persistent voice recording
addOrChange: Label the signal as disputed audio, not a later cosmic revelation.

cues.narration: After a digital collapse, communities built their own systems around local values and memories.
cues.visualAction: Reveal distinct archives shaped by different communities.

cues.narration: Now a dead man’s voice persists where the official record says it should not.
cues.visualAction: Continue the voice beside the record saying it should not exist.

scenes.title: The record disagrees
scenes.viewerPurpose: Follow an investigator across incompatible accounts Expect evidence tied to places and ordinary people
scenes.composition: Elias questions witnesses across borders and water services
addOrChange: Remove body and depth display, adding two witnesses and one practical map.

cues.narration: Investigator Elias Venn must navigate societies that disagree about what counts as truth.
cues.visualAction: Let witnesses offer different accounts without marking either false.

cues.narration: The search leads through borders, water systems, and people telling different stories about the same events.
cues.visualAction: Move from checkpoint to water map with both accounts retained.

scenes.title: Follow the signal
scenes.viewerPurpose: Notice why each community wants the discrepancy explained away Want to follow the contradiction without knowing its answer
scenes.composition: Elias compares three local records without a master version
addOrChange: Remove late-revelation console cues and retain one unexplained discrepancy.

cues.narration: Every community believes it governs itself, making each discrepancy harder to dismiss.
cues.visualAction: Align the independent accounts and expose their disagreement.

cues.narration: Follow the evidence into a world where independence may be more complicated than anyone admits.
cues.visualAction: Close with all accounts still in the investigator’s record.
